title: Theodosius overturns Philoponus's citations
english: I read Theodosius the Monk's careful reversal of the citations John Philoponus had taken up against the resurrection of the body, together with a laying out of scriptural and patristic sayings to expose John's vain labor.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824 p.5. Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.
Codex 22 of 279; Theodosius the Monk against Philoponus on the resurrection.
